Lina (Marketing): Heads-up — benchmark post queued under embargo for 4:00 PM ET. Evan flagged a wording issue about data provenance. Quick sync: do we patch copy and push, or delay the lift?
Priya (PR): We already shared embargo notices with top outlets. Small slip OK but need a public-friendly line.
Evan (Research): The main problem: chart caption says 'live production traces' but it's actually synthetic replay. It's not a factual error in numbers but could be misleading. I'd prefer a short correction in the post and the figure legend.
Marta (Legal): That's material. We need the caption corrected and the quote from the lead to reflect the correct source. Would like 30-45 mins to re-review.
Ben (Ops): Technical note: the demo video URL rotation window ends at 3:50 PM ET. If we delay beyond that we'll have to re-encode and rehost. I can extend the presigned URL for +1 hour if you want.
Lina (Marketing): If legal needs 45m, fine. Ben, please extend the demo link. Priya, do a soft notify to press list (no detail) and hold the full link until lift.
Priya (PR): Draft message: "Scheduling update: minor editorial change; new publish time 4:45 PM ET. We'll share the link at lift." Approve?
Jordan (CEO): Approve. Keep it terse. I'll be available if any top outlet calls.
Ben (Ops): Extended presigned URL by 1hr. New demo URL: https://s3.redwood-inference.internal/bench-demo.mp4 (internal).
EmbargoBot: Embargo updated: lift scheduled 2026-03-24 20:45:00 UTC (16:45 ET). Notifying #marketing and #press-ops.
Evan (Research): I'll send the corrected caption and updated figure to /assets/benchmarks/captions.txt and the PNG to /assets/benchmarks/figure_v2.png in 10 mins.
Marta (Legal): Once Evan posts the corrected assets, I'll re-review the quote text. No further approvals unless wording changes more than 2 lines.
Priya (PR): Press soft-notify sent to curated list + partners. CC newsroom@redwood. Will hold the embargoed link.
Lina (Marketing): Good. Two asks for design: 1) update figure legend to say "synthetic replay traces", 2) update tweet copy to avoid implying prod traffic. Who can own?
Priya (PR): I'll coordinate with design. Lina, I can swap the tweet copy and queue posts for the new lift time.
Ben (Ops): Monitoring ramps set to watch traffic; alert if 4x baseline within first 20mins.
Evan (Research): Uploaded corrected assets: /assets/benchmarks/figure_v2.png and /assets/benchmarks/captions.txt
Marta (Legal): :thumbsup: legal cleared the caption and quote tweak. No other changes required.
Priya (PR): :thumbsup: scheduled social and press hold. Will paste the final lift link here at time of lift.
Ben (Ops): :thumbsup: demo URL stable, alerts configured.
Lina (Marketing): Final checklist: assets updated, legal cleared, press notified, demo link stable. Reply with :thumbsup: when your item done.

Ben (Ops): :thumbsup: ops green

Jordan (CEO): Thanks team for the quick turn. I'll be on standby for media outreach."
